description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (1.50 each), grants [Attach Water], [Awoken Water], [Damage Cap +10000] and [Marine Wave Follow-Up] to the user

description.name: Awoken Water
description.text: Water abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Water abilities trigger 1 additional time

description.name: Attach Water
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Water damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Water resistance +20%

description.name: Marine Wave Follow-Up
description.text: Casts Marine Wave 1/2 after using 1/2+2n Water abilities

description.name: Debuff Fire 10% (15s)
description.text: Reduces Fire damage dealt by 10%, cumulable

description.name: Marine Wave 2
description.text: Four single attacks (2.04 each), grants [Buff Water 10% (15s)] to all allies

description.name: Buff Water 10% (15s)
description.text: Increases Water damage dealt by 10%, cumulable
